note: Lonnie's crew and similar street toughs. Threat without slurs; scripted encounters mostly.

lines.text: Nice night. Shame to waste it.
Lonnie says hello. Lonnie says a lot of things.
You bumped me. Now we got a problem.
He's heading for Penn Station! Cut him off!
Envelope looks heavy, collector. Want help carrying it?
Lost him. Lonnie's gonna be sore.
Look who's back on our corner. You paying rent now?
You helped Manny out. Fine. You walk through. Once.
Wrong block, friend. Turn around while you still got legs.
You shot at my boys. You're a dead man on Ninth.
Whoa, whoa! No piece, no piece! We was just talking!

memoryNote: greet_known/antagonize/fear (sim pedGreets 39af2cb). 'recall' = helped | robbed | violence; untagged lines are a familiar face.
